title: Scioccherie di poeti!
subtitle: Ferrando, Guglielmo and Don Alfonso: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 1

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 1, recitative after No. 2
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (Poeti, Or bene, cóstanti, sièn, fè, Penelopi).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 17–19, the recitative between No. 2 and No. 3 (39 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (two errors found and corrected, then clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words, the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. The first bar has three beats and is set as 3/4: Ferrando's first two syllables, Scioc-che-, are the upbeat in the last bar of No. 2, so this piece starts on -rie; Guglielmo's last word ends (-re-mo?) in the first bar of No. 3 (attacca). Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 103, from the median length of seven recordings (Böhm, Haitink, Solti, Nézet-Séguin, Currentzis, Gardiner, Marriner; about 1½ minutes).
